doc: Labelled accuracy set for audit findings (G18). One case per decision a customer can check: a site-wide finding is one case, a page-level finding is one case per page it lists (`finding` is "category|title" or "category|title@url"). `label` is the judgement a careful human gives after looking at the evidence in `source`: `true_positive` the finding is raised and correct, `false_positive` the finding would be wrong on this site and must not be raised, `cosmetic` the claim is true but not worth reporting (counted and listed, left out of precision). The scorer (score.js) runs the real audit nodes - Build Probes / Content Probes / Analyze Probes / Build Site Issues - over the site fixtures in `sites/` and scores what they emit. Precision = true_positive / (true_positive + false_positive) must stay at or above 95% (scenario S49); a finding with no case here fails the scenario, so a new finding has to be labelled before it can ship. The fixtures are free public fetches of 2026-10-12 (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, the homepage twice, the crawler-access probes and each page once; see capture.js) - no paid API is involved. Read `n8n/seo-agent/ACCURACY_SET.md` first.

sites.note: the customer site of the 2026-10-11 review: a Next.js site on Vercel, apex 308 to www, three theme-color tags (D18), placeholder text live on /industries
OpenPeppol, a non-profit standards body on WordPress: www 301 to the apex, an empty "Disallow:" in robots.txt, no llms.txt, ClaudeBot blocked by the CDN, pages with no description and no H1
a UAE Oracle NetSuite partner on Webflow behind Cloudflare: apex 301 to www, a full llms.txt, every crawler served, nav-heavy pages

cases.finding: Performance|HTML cannot be cached by the CDN (no-store / private)
cases.label: true_positive
cases.reason: The homepage really answers with "Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate" and x-vercel-cache MISS on both requests, so no CDN copy is ever served.
cases.source: fixture probes.home_content headers; the same was checked by hand against the live site in RESULTS.md section 2.5 ("true")

cases.label: true_positive
cases.reason: The live page carries 30 matches of "Lorem ipsum" / "dolor sit amet" under the "Industry Context" headings.
cases.source: checked live on 2026-10-12 (free fetch, 30 matches); first found by the review (RESULTS.md section 2.5, "true")

cases.finding: Crawlability & Indexing|www and non-www versions are not consolidated
cases.label: false_positive
cases.reason: https://techand.ai/ answers 308 to https://www.techand.ai/ and the homepage canonical names www.techand.ai: there is exactly one host. The audit raised this as a High finding in every run up to 2026-10-11 (D6), on DataForSEO's test_canonicalization flag alone.
cases.source: RESULTS.md section 2.5 ("false positive (D6)"); fixed and live-verified in LIVE_CHECK_phase1_2026-10-12.md section 2, D6

cases.finding: On-Page|Duplicate meta tags on the same page@https://www.techand.ai/
cases.label: false_positive
cases.reason: The crawler counts the three Next.js <meta name="theme-color"> tags (light / dark / no media) as duplicates of each other. They differ by their media attribute, so they are correct markup and nothing is duplicated. The audit reported "Duplicate meta tags, 45/47 pages" on 2026-10-11 (D18).
cases.source: RESULTS.md section 2.5 ("false positive (D18)"); fixed and live-verified in LIVE_CHECK_phase1_2026-10-12.md section 2, D18; the three tags are in the fixture's stored <head>

cases.finding: Crawlability & Indexing|Indexable pages missing from the sitemap
cases.label: false_positive
cases.reason: All six crawled pages are listed in sitemap.xml. The sitemap lists them on www.techand.ai while a crawl may report either host, so a host-sensitive comparison would wrongly flag every page.
cases.source: fixture probes.sitemap (45 locs) against the six crawled URLs

cases.finding: AI Search Readiness|robots.txt blocks some AI crawlers
cases.label: false_positive
cases.reason: techand.ai's robots.txt has one "User-Agent: *" group with Allow: / and three path rules (/api/, /admin/, /private/): no AI crawler is blocked.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.reason: https://techand.ai/llms.txt answers 200 with 10,659 characters of plain text.

cases.finding: AI Search Readiness|Some search and AI crawlers are blocked or get less content
cases.label: false_positive
cases.reason: All 11 crawler user-agents get HTTP 200 and between 218,854 and 219,161 characters against the browser's 219,161 - differences of a few hundred bytes from A/B markers. A strict length comparison would call Bingbot and Applebot blocked.

cases.finding: AI Search Readiness|Some search and AI crawlers are blocked or get less content
cases.label: true_positive
cases.reason: ClaudeBot gets HTTP 403 and a 146-character body where a browser gets 130,836 characters: the CDN blocks that crawler by user-agent, while the other ten are served in full.
cases.source: the site fixture of 2026-10-12 (harness/accuracy/sites/peppol-org.json) probes["bot:ClaudeBot"] (403, 146 characters)
